subject.title: Bug: sandbox.mode: "non-main" silently breaks sessions_spawn subagent initialization

question: Should sandboxed `sessions_spawn` startup failures keep the accepted async contract and terminalize later, or should sandbox startup be preflighted before returning accepted?
rationale: Both choices can solve the user-visible hang, but the decision affects the public accepted response contract, lifecycle events, registry/session state, gateway wait behavior, and overlap with #58776/#77415.

options.title: Terminalize Async Startup Failure
options.body: Keep the accepted async contract and add typed/logged startup failure state visible through `subagents list`, session history, and gateway waits.

options.title: Preflight Before Accept
options.body: Validate enough sandbox startup before returning accepted, trading clearer immediate failures for added latency and compatibility risk in callers.

options.title: Defer To Broader Lifecycle Work
options.body: Keep this issue open only as the Docker-backed proof case while #58776 owns the new lifecycle event contract.

recommendation.title: Terminalize Async Startup Failure
recommendation.body: Keep the accepted async contract and add typed/logged startup failure state visible through `subagents list`, session history, and gateway waits.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recorded overlap across sessions_spawn sandbox inheritance, subagent registry lifecycle, and terminal outcome paths.
